verdict.rationale: First-party docs describe durable BM25 text indexes over string properties on nodes and edges. They also describe full-text search living in the same engine as graph and vector data, with ACID transactions spanning text data, so no separate store needs to be synchronized. The llms.txt probe corroborates that BM25 full-text search is built in. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of text search quality, and documentation detail on tokenization/analyzers, phrase or fuzzy queries, and hybrid scoring.
